pairs.question: Quid est agrum bene colere?
pairs.derivation: Cato poses a genuine interrogative and answers it himself: 'Quid est agrum bene colere? Bene arare.' The answer is the complete two-word reply to its full stop. The immediately following exchanges in the source ('Quid secundum? Arare. Quid tertium? Stercorare.') are separate elliptical follow-up questions that depend on this one for their referent, so they are not extracted as standalone self-contained pairs. The section marker '[61]' was stripped as scaffolding.
